training_outline.question:
Write a script outline for:
  title: Split Second
  logline: A bomb disposal tech has ninety seconds to defuse a device her own estranged brother built.
  genre/tone: tense procedural thriller

Structure it as a three-act outline in Markdown: Act headings, then a numbered list of plot beats/scenes under each act, each beat one to three sentences stating what happens, who it happens to, and where. Number every beat sequentially across the whole document (Beat 1, Beat 2, ...) so later stages can reference them unambiguously.

Emit as ONE path-bearing fence at scripts/split-second/outline.md. No other commentary outside the fence.
training_outline.answer:
```markdown scripts/split-second/outline.md
# SPLIT SECOND — OUTLINE

## Act One
1. Bomb Squad HQ, morning briefing — Tech Maren Cole is called to an active device downtown; her captain warns the build signature matches a known bomber's style.
2. Downtown parking structure — Maren arrives, suits up, and gets her first close look at the device, noting a personal engraving that unsettles her.
3. Command van — Maren confirms with the bomb database that the build technique belongs to her estranged brother, Eli, presumed dead for three years.

## Act Two
4. Parking structure, device — Maren begins the disarm sequence; the timer starts counting down from ninety seconds when she cuts the first wire wrong.
5. Command van — Eli's voice comes over a hidden radio built into the device, taunting and guiding her simultaneously.
6. Parking structure, device — Maren must choose between the manual she trained on and Eli's live instructions, unsure if he wants her to survive.
7. Command van — Captain orders evacuation of the block; Maren refuses to abandon the defusal with forty seconds left.

## Act Three
8. Parking structure, device — Maren recognizes a childhood signal hidden in Eli's wiring pattern and uses it to identify the real kill switch.
9. Parking structure, device — Maren defuses the device with six seconds remaining.
10. Rooftop across the street — Maren finds Eli watching from a distance; he disappears before backup arrives, leaving only the question of why he built it.
```

training_scene_cards.question:
OUTLINE:
# SPLIT SECOND — OUTLINE

## Act Two
5. Command van — Eli's voice comes over a hidden radio built into the device, taunting and guiding her simultaneously.

For every numbered beat in the outline, write one scene card as its own Markdown file: scripts/split-second/scenes/scene-<NN>.md (NN zero-padded to the beat number). Each scene card must contain: a level-1 heading with the scene's slugline (INT./EXT. LOCATION - DAY/NIGHT), a Characters Present list, a Goal line (what the protagonist of the scene wants), a Conflict line (what opposes it), and a 2-4 sentence beat summary matching the outline.

Emit each scene card as its own path-bearing fence. No other commentary outside the fences.
training_scene_cards.answer:
```markdown scripts/split-second/scenes/scene-05.md
# INT. COMMAND VAN - DAY

**Characters Present:** Maren Cole, Captain Reyes, Eli Cole (voice only)

**Goal:** Maren wants to identify the source of the radio transmission without losing focus on the live device.

**Conflict:** Eli's voice is both a threat and a possible lifeline, and Maren cannot tell which until it's too late to matter.

The van's radio crackles and locks onto a frequency no one dialed in. Eli's voice fills the space, calm and familiar, walking through wire colors that don't match the manual. Reyes orders the channel cut; Maren refuses, certain the voice is the only thing keeping her ahead of the clock.
```

training_bible.answer:

training_script.question:
Write the full script for "Split Second" in standard script format (scene headings in caps, action lines in present tense, character cues centered in caps above dialogue, parentheticals sparingly).

OUTLINE:
5. Command van — Eli's voice comes over a hidden radio built into the device, taunting and guiding her simultaneously.

SCENE CARDS (one scene per outline beat — cover every one, in order):
Scene 5: INT. COMMAND VAN - DAY. Characters: Maren, Reyes, Eli (voice). Goal: identify the transmission source. Conflict: the voice is both threat and lifeline.

CHARACTER BIBLE (stay consistent with these voices and motivations):
Eli Cole — voice only until scene 10, even, unhurried, unsettlingly gentle.
Maren Cole — controlled voice that tightens under pressure.

LOCATIONS:
Command Van — cramped mobile unit, radio racks and a single monitor feeding the suit cam.

Emit the complete script as ONE path-bearing fence at scripts/split-second/script.md. No other commentary outside the fence.
training_script.answer:
```markdown scripts/split-second/script.md
INT. COMMAND VAN - DAY

The radio rack hisses, then locks onto a frequency no one dialed. REYES reaches for the dial. MAREN blocks his hand.

ELI (V.O.)
(calm, unhurried)
Red before black, Maren. They moved the red.

REYES
That's not on any assigned channel. Cut it.

MAREN
(tight)
He's on the suit cam feed. He can see the device.

ELI (V.O.)
I can see you.

Maren stares at the monitor, jaw set, and does not reach for the dial.
```
